requirements: Claude Code on Windows, Mac or Linux; the first run installs its free tools (Python, FFmpeg, a local Kokoro voice). ElevenLabs is optional.

preview.description: A 50-second lecture-style explainer reel: a lip-synced cartoon teacher, slides and a typing terminal that land on the spoken word, captions that build, and a loop back to the first frame.
